title: 第9章 真的只是按摩
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 咚、咚、咚。没人开门。苏沐雪皱了皱眉，正准备再敲，门锁突然传来“咔哒”一声轻响。防盗门被人从里面拉开一条缝，一股浓郁到有些呛鼻的玫瑰花香瞬间涌了出来，甚至盖过了楼道里的油烟味。一个头发乱糟糟、穿着大裤衩和白背心的男生出现在门口。他显然刚进行过剧烈运动，额前的碎发湿漉漉地贴在苍白的皮肤上。呼吸还有些急促，手里抓着一个奇怪的玻璃小瓶子。苏沐雪愣了一下。这张脸……有点眼熟。她在脑海里飞快检索了一遍，终于在一个不起眼的角落里找到了对应的名字。叶凛。班上那个总是睡不醒、毫无存在感的路人甲。上一世完全没听过这号人物，估计和她一样，只是个碌碌无为一辈子的普通人。原来他也住这儿？苏沐雪心里有些失望。她原本以为开门的会是夏晚晴，没想到是个无关紧要的路人甲。“有事？”叶凛靠在门框上，眼皮耷拉着，一副没睡醒的样子。他看苏沐雪的眼神很平淡，没有平日里那些男生见到她时的惊艳或讨好。反倒带有一种被打扰的不耐烦？苏沐雪忍住心里的不适，维持着高冷的人设：“我找夏晚晴。”“她在忙。”叶凛言简意赅，抓着门把手就要关门。对他来说，任何打扰他休息或者赚钱的人，都是敌人。尤其是这种看起来就很麻烦、浑身上下写着“我是主角”的漂亮女人。“等等！”苏沐雪急了，下意识伸手撑住门框。这人有病吧？话都不让人说完？就在这时——屋内，那张并不隔音的单人床上，突然传来了一声高亢且带着哭腔的哀嚎。“叶凛……你个禽兽……下手太狠了……疼死我了……”“你要对我负责啊……”声音婉转，余音绕梁。空气突然安静。苏沐雪整个人僵在原地，撑着门框的手指僵硬得像是在抽筋。那张维持着高冷女神范儿的脸瞬间裂开，表情管理全面崩盘。这声音……是夏晚晴？那个手持金箍棒、一棍碎山河的齐天大圣代行者？在这个神话复苏、人类生死存亡的紧要关头，这两个人躲在狭窄的出租屋里……苏沐雪的视线僵硬地移向叶凛手里那瓶粉红色的精油。又看了看他满头大汗、衣衫不整的样子。以及那满屋子甜腻暧昧的玫瑰花香。苏沐雪瞬间脑补出来了一些浏览器历史记录里的剧情。原来……这就是强者变强的“秘诀”吗？这也太不知廉耻了！叶凛倒是很淡定。他手里还抓着那瓶只剩个底儿的晨曦玫瑰精油，看着门口这位如同被雷劈了的校花，甚至还打了个哈欠。“听见了？”叶凛指了指屋内，“她没空，爽着呢。”苏沐雪喉咙发干。爽……爽着呢？看着叶凛的眼神瞬间变了。夏晚晴上一世不是单身吗？！她哪来的男朋友？她有男朋友我怎么接近她？难道要编个共同爱好，跟眼前这人说“好巧啊，你喜欢夏晚晴，我也喜欢夏晚晴”。“那个……我……”苏沐雪拼命在心里告诉自已：苏沐雪，你是重生的，成大事者不拘小节。为了接近齐天大圣，为了活下去，这点精神污染算什么？忍一忍！“我是来找夏晚晴谈合租的。”苏沐雪深吸一口气，努力让自已的声音听起来不那么颤抖。“不租。”叶凛拒绝得干脆利落，手上的力道加重，门板向内合拢，“满员了，没地儿。”“我可以和晚晴住一间！”苏沐雪语速飞快，生怕门关上。“她介意。”叶凛面无表情，“而且我不想家里多个陌生人，麻烦。”门缝只剩下一条线了。苏沐雪急了。这人怎么油盐不进？难道非要逼她用那一招？“我分摊一半的房租！”这句话喊出来的瞬间，苏沐雪的心脏狠狠抽搐了一下。这里的房租虽然便宜，但分摊下来一个月也要大几百。而且还有押金什么的。这对她这个只有两万多存款的“穷鬼”来说，每一分钱都是从牙缝里省出来的血汗。但为了那个惊天的秘密，为了抱上未来大佬的大腿，这笔投资必须得花！吱呀——原本即将关上的防盗门，在听到“一半房租”这四个字的瞬间，猛地停住了。然后，以一种极其丝滑的速度重新打开。甚至比刚才开得还要大。叶凛靠在门边，原本那副死鱼眼的表情瞬间消失不见，变得和蔼可亲，如沐春风。说是看到亲爹也不为过。苏沐雪人都傻了。这啥变脸？“一半？”叶凛上下打量了苏沐雪一眼，不再是不耐烦，而是像在看一只待宰的肥羊。“你是说，原本一千五的房租，你出七百五？”“对。”苏沐雪咬着牙点头。“水电费呢？”“……平摊。”“成交。”叶凛侧身让出一条路，脸上的笑容真诚得让人害怕：“进来吧，不用换鞋，反正也没鞋柜和多余的拖鞋。”苏沐雪：“……”她看着叶凛那副见钱眼开的嘴脸，心里有些鄙夷。见钱眼开，真是个肤浅的男人。上一世，这种人死的最快。不过也好。只要进了这个门，凭她的手段和重生的先知优势，还怕搞不定现阶段还只是傻白甜的夏晚晴？苏沐雪整理了一下心情，迈步走进屋内。刚一进门，那股更加浓郁的玫瑰香气就扑面而来，熏得她脑子有点晕。房间很小，客厅里堆满了杂物，只留下一条窄窄的过道。那张单人床就在客厅的一角。苏沐雪一眼就看到了趴在床上的夏晚晴。听到动静，夏晚晴艰难地从枕头里抬起头。那张原本英气十足的脸，此刻布满了红晕，眼神迷离，嘴里还在哼哼唧唧。“老叶……谁啊……是不是外卖到了？”“饿死我了……刚才消耗太大……感觉身体被掏空……”苏沐雪：“……”消耗太大？她看着这一幕，心里五味杂陈。这就是未来的唯一华夏神代行者吗？怎么看都像是个被渣男骗财骗色还帮人数钱的无知少女啊！这叶凛到底给未来的大圣灌了什么迷魂汤？！“这是你的新室友。”叶凛走过去，完全没有一点避嫌的意思。他抬起手，毫不客气地一巴掌拍在夏晚晴挺翘的臀大肌上。啪——！“起来接客，别装死。”苏沐雪的眼皮狠狠跳了一下，瞳孔地震。他怎么敢？！那可是未来的斗战胜佛代行者！那可是能一棍子打爆无数七阶强者的天下第一人！他是真的不想活了吗？！这种亵渎代行者的行为，要是放在上一世，足够他被狂热的信徒撕成碎片一万次！“嗷——！”夏晚晴被打得嗷了一嗓子，像只炸毛的猫一样从床上弹了起来。“叶凛你大爷！手劲儿这么大想谋杀啊！”她揉着受创部位，一边呲牙咧嘴地转过身，终于清醒了几分。视线聚焦。她看清了站在门口一脸便秘表情的苏沐雪。夏晚晴的动作僵住了。两秒钟后。她瞪大了眼睛，嘴巴张成了O型，指着苏沐雪，结结巴巴地喊道：“卧槽？苏……苏校花？！”“你怎么在我家？！”紧接着，她像是意识到了什么，抓起被她的怪力攥到有些破了的杯子。最后看向一脸“我懂，我都懂”表情的苏沐雪。夏晚晴的脸，蹭地一下，红到了脖子根。“不……不是你想的那样！”“我们是在按摩！真的！”苏沐雪深吸一口气，露出了一个看破红尘的微笑。“没关系，我理解。”“现在的年轻人，玩得都挺花。”
content_en: Boom, boom, boom.No one opened the door.Su Muxue frowned and was about to knock again when a soft "click" sound suddenly came from the door lock.The security door was opened a crack from the inside, and a strong and pungent rose fragrance instantly poured out, even covering up the smell of oil smoke in the corridor.A boy with messy hair, wearing big pants and a white vest appeared at the door.He had obviously just done strenuous exercise, and the strands of hair on his forehead were wet and stuck to his pale skin.His breathing was still a little rapid, and he was holding a strange small glass bottle in his hand.Su Muxue was stunned for a moment.This face... looks familiar.She searched quickly in her mind and finally found the corresponding name in an inconspicuous corner.Ye Lin.That passer-by in class who is always awake and has no sense of existence.I had never heard of this person in my previous life. He was probably just an ordinary person who had been doing nothing for his whole life, just like her.So he lives here too?Su Muxue felt a little disappointed.She originally thought the person who opened the door would be Xia Wanqing, but she didn't expect it to be an insignificant passerby."Is something wrong?" Ye Lin leaned against the door frame, his eyelids drooping, as if he hadn't woken up.The way he looked at Su Muxue was very dull, not as surprised or flattering as those boys usually did when they saw her.On the contrary, there is a kind of impatience of being disturbed?Su Muxue held back her discomfort and maintained her cold persona: "I'm looking for Xia Wanqing." "She's busy." Ye Lin spoke concisely and grabbed the door handle to close the door.To him, anyone who disturbs his rest or money is an enemy.Especially this kind of beautiful woman who looks troubled and has "I am the protagonist" written all over her body."Wait!" Su Muxue was anxious and subconsciously stretched out her hand to hold the door frame.Is this person sick?Don't you even want to finish your words?At this moment - a high-pitched and tearful wail suddenly came from the single bed in the house, which was not soundproof."Ye Lin... you beast... you were too cruel... it hurts me to death..." "You have to be responsible for me..." The voice was gentle and lingering.The air was suddenly quiet.Su Muxue froze in place, and her fingers holding the door frame were so stiff that she seemed to be cramping.The face that maintained the look of a cold goddess cracked instantly, and the expression management completely collapsed.This voice...is it Xia Wanqing?The Monkey King holding a golden cudgel and smashing mountains and rivers with one stick?At this critical moment when mythology is resurrected and humanity's survival is at risk, these two people hide in a narrow rental house... Su Muxue's eyes moved stiffly to the bottle of pink essential oil in Ye Lin's hand.I looked at him again, sweating profusely and disheveled.And the sweet and ambiguous fragrance of roses fills the room.Su Muxue instantly figured out some plots in the browser history.It turns out... is this the "secret" for the strong to become stronger?This is so shameless!Ye Lin was very calm.He was still holding the bottle of Dawn Rose Essential Oil that was all but empty. He looked at the school belle at the door who seemed to have been struck by lightning, and even yawned."Did you hear that?" Ye Lin pointed to the room, "She's not free, she's feeling good." Su Muxue's throat was dry.Feeling good... are you feeling good?The look in Ye Lin's eyes changed instantly.Wasn't Xia Wanqing single in her last life?!Where did she get her boyfriend?How can I get close to her when she has a boyfriend?Do you want to make up a common hobby and say to the person in front of you, "What a coincidence, you like Xia Wanqing, and I also like Xia Wanqing.""That...I..." Su Muxue desperately told herself in her heart: Su Muxue, you are reborn, and those who achieve great things do not stick to trivial matters.In order to get close to the Monkey King, in order to survive, what does this little bit of mental pollution mean?Bear with it!"I'm here to talk to Xia Wanqing about renting together." Su Muxue took a deep breath and tried to make her voice less shaky."No rent." Ye Lin refused flatly, and the force on his hand increased, and the door panel closed inward, "It's full, there's no room." "I can share a room with Wan Qing!" Su Muxue spoke quickly, for fear of the door closing."She minds." Ye Lin said expressionlessly, "And I don't want the trouble of having many strangers at home." There was only a thin line left in the door.Su Muxue was anxious.Why doesn't this person get enough oil and salt?Do we have to force her to use that move?"I'll share half of the rent!" The moment she shouted these words, Su Muxue's heart twitched violently.Although the rent here is cheap, it still costs several hundred dollars a month when spread out.And there's a deposit and so on.For her, a "poor person" with only more than 20,000 yuan in savings, every penny she spent was the hard work she saved through her teeth.But for that shocking secret and to get into the lap of the future boss, this investment must be spent!Squeak - the security door that was about to close suddenly stopped when it heard the words "half the rent".Then, reopen at an extremely silky speed.Even wider than before.Ye Lin leaned against the door, and the dead fish-eyed expression disappeared instantly, becoming amiable and like a spring breeze.It's not an exaggeration to say that he saw his biological father.Su Muxue was dumbfounded.What's this change of face?"Half?" Ye Lin looked Su Muxue up and down, no longer impatient, but like he was looking at a fat sheep waiting to be slaughtered."You mean, you're paying 750 for the originally 1,500 yuan rent?" "Yes." Su Muxue gritted her teeth and nodded."Where's the water and electricity bill?" "...Split it equally." "Deal." Ye Lin stepped aside to make way, and the smile on his face was so sincere that it made people scared: "Come in, there is no need to change shoes, and there is no shoe cabinet or extra slippers anyway." Su Muxue: "..." She looked at Ye Lin's face that was so open to money, and she felt a little disdainful.He is really a superficial man who is blind to money.In the previous life, this kind of people died the fastest.But that’s fine.As long as she enters this door, with her methods and the advantages of reborn prophet, are she afraid that she might be able to deal with Xia Wanqing, who is still just silly and sweet at this stage?Su Muxue calmed down and walked into the house.As soon as she walked in, the stronger scent of roses hit her face, making her feel a little dizzy.The room was small, and the living room was filled with clutter, leaving only a narrow passage.The single bed is in the corner of the living room.Su Muxue saw Xia Wanqing lying on the bed at a glance.Hearing the noise, Xia Wanqing raised her head from the pillow with difficulty.The originally heroic face was now covered with blush, his eyes were blurred, and he was still humming."Old Ye... who is it... has the takeaway arrived?" "I'm starving... I consumed too much just now... I feel like my body has been hollowed out..." Su Muxue: "..." I consumed too much?She looked at this scene with mixed feelings in her heart.Is this the only representative of the Chinese gods in the future?No matter how you look at it, she looks like an ignorant girl who was defrauded of money and sex by a scumbag and then helped pass the money!What kind of ecstasy soup did Ye Lin pour into the future great sage?!"This is your new roommate." Ye Lin walked over without any intention of avoiding suspicion.He raised his hand and slapped Xia Wanqing's erected gluteus maximus unceremoniously.Snap——!"Get up and pick up the guests, don't pretend to be dead." Su Muxue's eyelids twitched hard, and her pupils were shaking.How dare he?!That is the future battle to defeat the Buddha’s vicarious practitioner!That is the number one person in the world who can defeat countless seventh-level powerhouses with one stick!Does he really not want to live?!This kind of blasphemy against the agent would have been enough to tear him into pieces ten thousand times by fanatical believers in his previous life!"Ouch——!" Xia Wanqing screamed from the beating and jumped up from the bed like a cat with explosive fur."Ye Lin, you uncle! You have such strong hands that you want to commit murder!" She rubbed the injured area and turned around with a grin on her face, finally waking up a little.Focused sight.She saw clearly Su Muxue standing at the door with a constipated expression on her face.Xia Wanqing's movements froze.Two seconds later.Her eyes widened, her mouth opened into an O shape, she pointed at Su Muxue, and stammered: "Fuck? Su... Su school beauty?!" "Why are you at my house?!" Then, as if she realized something, she grabbed the cup that was slightly broken by her strange strength.Finally, he looked at Su Muxue who had an "I understand, I understand" expression on her face.Xia Wanqing's face was red to the root of her neck."No...it's not what you think!" "We are having a massage! Really!" Su Muxue took a deep breath and showed a smile that could see through the world."It's okay, I understand." "Young people nowadays have a lot of fun."
